text:
Eli: Escalating P1 -> trial account 'ClearHarbor' (ACC CLR-472). Onboarding graphs failing intermittently during embed ingestion, customers hitting timeouts and a hard demo in 6h. Renewal discussion next week 10k ARR2024-05. Need CS owner for comms + a mitigation path.
Rhea: I'm taking this. Thanks Eli. Can you drop the last request ids + any client logs? We'll need to message the AE and prepare a fallback.
Eli: req=ch-77b4, error: `ingest_error: upstream timeout after 12000ms`; stack shows repeated cache misses and a surge of large contexts from the SDK.
Sam: Possible quick win: switch the trial to `redwood-lite-emb-v2` for lower per-request memory and enable conservative batching. I can script the change and a short guide for the customer.
Noah: I'll check routing and cache warm state. If TTLs expired unexpectedly, that'd explain spikes. Opening INF-1301 to track.
ops-bot: INF-1301 created by @Noah -> status: investigating
Rhea: Comms plan (short): 1) Send note to Jas (jas@clearharbor.com) apologizing + schedule an interim 30-min call before the demo at 09:30 PT 2) Provide workaround: switch to lite embed model + short SDK flag to limit context length 3) Promise post-demo RCA and credit if SLA impacted. I'll draft and own outreach.
Eli: AE is cc'd on the ticket. Customer replied on support thread: "We need this sorted before demo or we'll postpone."
Sam: I'll prepare a runbook snippet to post in the case: `curl -X POST /v1/accounts/ACC-CLR-472/override -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-emb-v2","max_context":2048}'` and a rollback command.
Noah: INF-1301 update: found that fallback routing thresholds had drifted after last config refresh. Pushing an emergency override for ACC CLR-472 to route to lite model. Monitoring now.
Rhea: Roles: CS lead = Rhea, Support lead = Eli, Solutions = Sam, Infra = Noah. Case id CS-ESC-2026-089. Rhea will send initial email and run the pre-demo check at 08:45 PT.
Eli: Posting a short support note to case: "Mitigation applied: lite model override; monitoring. Customer notified; demo owners alerted."
Rhea: We'll offer a one-month service credit if the demo fails due to platform issues. Also adding an enablement checklist for AE to reduce context size when running demos.
Sam: After the demo, I'll join the RCA to capture root cause and an action list: autoscale thresholds, cache prewarm, SDK limits, smarter routing.
Noah: INF-1301 -> override applied at 3187658321; metrics show latency dropping from 1200ms p95 to ~320ms. Keeping watch for 30m.
Rhea: Thanks everyone. I'll send the customer note and schedule the pre-demo sync. Moving follow-ups to CS case CS-ESC-2026-089 and infra INF-1301. :thumbsup:
